title: ChangeBrief
description: Output of solidsdd.brief: structured scope for one change—goals, in/out of scope, assumptions. Return point when later judgment is ambiguous. Not a living product PRD. Scope lists use {id,text} objects for mechanical coverage.

change_id.description: Meaningful kebab-case id; must match the directory name under .solidsdd/changes/.

goal.description: What success looks like for this change (problem to solve / outcome).

in_scope.description: Explicit list of what this change includes. Prefer ids R1, R2, …

out_of_scope.description: Explicit list of what this change excludes (non-goals). Prefer ids X1, X2, …

assumptions.description: Assumptions the rest of the loop may rely on.

success_criteria.description: Whole-change success checks (later mapped by decompose / integration verify). Prefer ids SC1, SC2, … Prefer observable outcomes, not implementation tactics.

open_questions.description: Unresolved items; usually imply low confidence and/or human_gate.

id.description: Stable id within this Brief (e.g. R1, SC1, X1).

text.description: Human-readable scope statement in the working language.
